direction: unit-norm mean difference, group A (101 rows) minus group B (88 rows)

zero_strength_check.meaning: alpha=0 reproduces the unmodified baseline exactly at every layer

intervention_fires.meaning: add_scaled propagates to logits; the hook is deterministic; a no-op hook is inert

direction_norm_ratios._note: raw |v| divided by mean activation norm at the same layer

interpretation.primary: No behavioural effect was detectable at any pilot layer for |alpha| <= 2. The margin moved by at most 0.027 logits against a ~9.4 baseline margin.
interpretation.mechanism: At |alpha|=2 the unit direction perturbs the residual stream by 0.7-5.5% of its local norm. That is below the threshold needed to change the argmax over a 2-way answer.
interpretation.consequence: A raw alpha sweep on a normalized direction does not equalize effective dose across layers. Layer 26 receives 7.5x less relative perturbation than layer 4 at the same alpha.
interpretation.next_step: Calibrate alpha per layer against the measured margin response, then re-sweep. A shared alpha grid cannot answer the layer-dependence question on its own.
interpretation.not_tested: H3 (held-out generalization) and H4 (cross-layer transfer) were not run. The evaluation split was deliberately left untouched.
